description: This PHP class 'ChannelSectionTransformer' is part of the Goteo project, specifically in the namespace for model normalization transformers. It extends an abstract transformer to provide transformation logic for channel section models, including retrieving section data and generating relevant action URLs based on user permissions.

classes.name: ChannelSectionTransformer
classes.description: A transformer class for channel section models, providing data extraction and action URL generation based on user permissions.

methods.name: getSection
methods.description: Returns the section associated with the model.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Generates a list of action URLs for editing, deleting, and translating the channel section, depending on user permissions.
